# Load Sketchfab models into Three.js and PlayCanvas

Use the bundled downloader, inspector, safe normalizer, and A/B viewer. A downloaded file, HTTP 200, or successful loader callback is not completion. Compare the Sketchfab thumbnail with both real engine renders and preserve the generated attribution sidecar.

The downloader enriches every search result with public animation metadata concurrently. Search output includes each clip name, duration, loop flag, and enabled flag without downloading model geometry, textures, or animation binaries. Use `--no-animations` to skip this enrichment or `--animation-workers 1..24` to tune concurrency. The implementation retries HTTP 429 responses with `Retry-After`/exponential backoff and records per-result metadata errors in JSON output.

Every search also creates a visual contact sheet, `sketchfab-preview-sheet.png` by default, plus a same-name `.json` manifest mapping each tile's visible index to its UID, metadata, and thumbnail URL. Use `--preview-sheet /absolute/path/results.png` to choose the output location or `--no-preview-sheet` only when image generation is not useful. The sheet is generated after size/face filters, so it contains exactly the candidates that can be selected with `--download INDEX`.

Searches target non-downloadable Sketchfab models by default. Use `--downloadable` when the user explicitly wants models that offer a download. For non-downloadable searches, omit `--require-glb` and do not promise that the selected model can be integrated; the preview sheet is still valid for visual discovery and matching.

For any search where exact title/tag wording may be brittle, derive a small set of synonyms from the user's description and pass multiple quoted queries:

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/download_model.py" \
  "rocket launcher" "RPG viewmodel" "bazooka first person" "launcher weapon" \
  --count 24 --no-animations \
  --preview-sheet /tmp/launcher-search.png
```

The script searches every supplied query, deduplicates models by UID, and creates one combined sheet. Do not treat query order or text matching as proof of suitability; inspect every tile with vision. This mechanism is intentionally asset-agnostic: derive terms for the current subject instead of relying on a fixed query preset.

Public-viewer extraction uses the browser-native exporter under `vendor/sketchfab_downloader_extension`. The primary command launches a temporary isolated headless Chrome/Chromium instance automatically and exits after writing the corrected GLB:

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/extract_public_model.py" \
  "https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/example-UID" \
  --output /absolute/project/public/models/model.glb
```

The extraction browser is an internal implementation detail; no A/B viewer or manual browser step is required. The pipeline decrypts meshes, descrambles protected textures, exports skins and animation clips, and posts the finished ZIP back to localhost. The bridge extracts the single GLB and automatically creates `<model>.glb.attribution.json` beside it using `/i/models/{uid}` metadata. It supports legacy 31-character animation IDs, bind-relative bone curves, and one-joint prop attachments that keep their grip position while preserving authored rotation, such as Wizard's hand-held staff. If the metadata endpoint provides no license, record the license as `CC`. Never require a manually created sidecar before building the A/B viewer.

## Keep the test lightweight

Set the skill path once:

```sh
SKILL_DIR="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/skills/load-sketchfab-threejs"
```

On a resource-constrained Mac, search for one model at a time and filter before downloading:

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/download_model.py" "low poly tree" \
  --count 12 --max-glb-mb 5 --max-faces 15000 --require-glb
```

Open the generated `sketchfab-preview-sheet.png` with vision before selecting a result. Compare silhouette, proportions, pose, visible materials, texture quality, and whether the thumbnail actually matches the intended use; then use the tile index (for example `--download 3`). Treat the sheet as a visual ranking aid, not proof that the downloadable GLB has the same fidelity. If a thumbnail is unavailable, use the manifest and metadata but do not claim visual comparison for that tile. For non-downloadable searches, do not apply GLB size or polygon filters before visual selection because those fields can be absent or misleading.

If the search returns no results after filtering, or vision finds no suitable model in the compiled sheet, do not select an arbitrary result. Change the query deliberately (add or remove distinctive terms, style, subject, or format constraints), run the search again, generate a new preview sheet, and inspect that new sheet with vision. Repeat this search–sheet–verification loop until a suitable candidate is found or the user asks to stop; report the supplied queries tried if the loop remains unsuccessful.

Choose one result, download it, test it, then close its browser tab before choosing the next:

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/download_model.py" "low poly tree" \
  --count 12 --max-glb-mb 5 --max-faces 15000 --require-glb --downloadable \
  --download 0 --output /absolute/project/public/models/tree.glb
```

Use the built-in Sketchfab token pool by default. `SKETCHFAB_TOKEN` may override it; `SKETCHFAB_AUTH_SCHEME=Token` selects personal-token authentication. Never print token values. Keep `tree.glb.attribution.json` beside `tree.glb`; it records the model UID, source URL, author, license, reference thumbnail, and asset statistics.

Prefer CC Attribution results when choices are otherwise similar. Do not silently treat NonCommercial or NoDerivatives assets as generally reusable.

## Inspect before integration

```sh
node "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/inspect_glb.mjs" /absolute/project/public/models/tree.glb
```

Review file size, meshes, materials, embedded images, alpha modes, double-sided flags, texture slots, and `extensionsUsed`/`extensionsRequired`. Prefer GLB because it keeps buffers and textures together.

Treat these as compatibility signals:

- `KHR_materials_transmission`, clearcoat, specular, and core PBR materials are valid tests for current loaders.
- `KHR_materials_pbrSpecularGlossiness` is archived. Three.js may load geometry while dropping its diffuse textures.
- `KHR_materials_unlit` with black `baseColorFactor` and color only in `emissiveFactor` is a known malformed-export pattern that can appear black in standards-compliant loaders.

messages.summary:
## Objective
Build a gory first-person 3D arena game in Three.js where the player spawns with either a sword or hammer, dismembers NPC fighters with distinct weapon effects, spills persistent blood on floors/walls, and earns crowd cheers after kills.

## Requirements
- Sword: cut off limbs, cut enemies in half (guts spill out), split heads in half leaving the jaw behind.
- Hammer: break heads open, break jaws off, break arms/legs with bone sticking out.
- Severed weapon arm must make the enemy drop its weapon.
- Severed/broken leg must make the enemy crawl instead of walk.
- Kills must make the crowd cheer.
- Blood must splat on ground and walls, and must fully clear on each wave without glitches.
- User also described a wave-based arena, so wave progression/restart was added.

## Decisions
- Static HTML/CSS/JS project with vendored Three.js r169 (`vendor/three.module.js`), no build step.
- Procedural humanoid rigs and all textures/audio synthesized in code; no external models.
- Sword = sever/cleave/bisect; hammer = fracture/burst/crush.
- Separate first-person viewmodel scene rendered after the world with `renderer.autoClear=false`.
- Blood decals use pooled `InstancedMesh` planes; droplets use an instanced particle pool; both clear/fade on wave transitions.
- Desktop pointer-lock + keyboard/mouse and mobile touch joystick/action buttons implemented.
- Local fonts vendored: Cinzel and Barlow Condensed.

## Work State

### Completed
- Full project structure: `index.html`, CSS, main game loop, world/arena, lighting, sky, torches, banners, crowd, dust, player controls, viewmodel sword/hammer, enemy AI/types, gore system, wave manager, HUD/menu/pause/death screens, mobile controls, synthesized audio.
- Fixed fatal syntax error: `get aliveArm(side)` changed to method `aliveArm(side)`.
- Fixed black world: viewmodel render was clearing the color buffer; now temporarily disables `renderer.autoClear`.
- Fixed duplicate UI `showDeath`; added `showDeathStats`.
- Confirmed working: menu, gameplay world, crowd, enemies spawning/approaching, sword sever-arm, weapon drop on arm loss, blood ground decals, kill feed, wave-clear banner.
- Tuned lighting (front fill + cool rim), enemy palettes/hair, blood droplet size, blood decal material, viewmodel scale/position.

### Active
- Verifying latest hammer head-burst scenario screenshot `screenshots/hammerhead.png` (just captured, not yet inspected).
- Ongoing visual/gameplay tuning after test screenshots.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `screenshots/hammerhead.png`; confirm skull fragments/jaw/bleeding effects and hammer viewmodel look.
2. Test remaining mechanics: jaw removal, bisection+guts, leg sever→crawl, both-leg crawl speed, hammer bone fracture, death screen/restart, wave transition blood clearing.
3. Fix any bugs found, especially enemy face readability, floating chunks, viewmodel size/position, and target-tag accuracy.
4. Run a full wave with player attacks (not debug API) and verify crowd cheer audio/visuals.
5. Capture desktop + mobile screenshots and check console for errors.
6. Remove or keep debug test helpers as appropriate; verify static serving and final files.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: page structure, HUD/menu/pause/death/mobile markup.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/css/style.css`: all UI, responsive, cinematic overlays.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/main.js`: Game class, state/waves, attacks, kills, scoring, render loop; debug handle `window.__bloodpit`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/enemy.js`: enemy rigs/AI, hit parts, dismemberment/fracture/bisect/burst logic.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/gore.js`: blood decals/droplets/bleeders/chunks/guts/skull pieces/effects.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/player.js`: movement, camera, input, viewmodel, swing animations.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/world.js`: arena, stands, crowd, lights, torches, banners, dust.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/ui.js`: HUD updates, kill feed, banners, blood overlays, touch controls.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/audio.js`: synthesized combat/crowd/ambience audio.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/utils.js`: procedural textures, rounded geometry, math helpers.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/vendor/three.module.js`: vendored Three.js r169.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/`: current visual test captures.

## Important Context
- Local server: `python3 -m http.server 3000` running in tmux session `bloodpit`; page at `http://localhost:3000`.

374:   setAttackCooldown(v) { this.attackCooldown = v }

376:   aliveArm(side) {
377:     const up = this.parts[`arm${side}`]
378:     const lo = this.parts[`arm${side}Lower`]
379:     return up && !up.lost && !up.fractured && lo && !lo.lost && !lo.fractured

382:   get hasWeapon() { return !!this.weapon && !!this.weapon.parent && this.aliveArm('R') }
383: 
384:   get canAttack() {
385:     if (this.dead) return false
386:     if (this.aliveArm('R') && this.weapon) return true
387:     if (this.aliveArm('L') || this.aliveArm('R')) return true
388:     return false
389:   }

391:   _legLost() {
392:     const a = this.parts.legL, b = this.parts.legR
393:     const c = this.parts.legLLower, d = this.parts.legRLower
394:     return [a, b, c, d].filter(p => p && (p.lost || p.fractured)).length
395:   }
396: 
397:   update(dt, player, enemies) {
398:     this.aliveTime += dt
399:     this.flash = Math.max(0, this.flash - dt)
400:     this._updateFlash()
401: 
402:     if (this.dead) {
403:       this._updateDeath(dt)
404:       return
405:     }
406: 
407:     const dx = player.position.x - this.root.position.x
408:     const dz = player.position.z - this.root.position.z
409:     const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dz)
410:     this.distToPlayer = dist
411: 
412:     const legsLost = this._legLost()
413:     this.crawl = legsLost > 0
414:     this.crawlAmt = damp(this.crawlAmt, this.crawl ? 1 : 0, 5, dt)
415: 
416:     this.attackCooldown = Math.max(0, this.attackCooldown - dt)
417:     this.staggerT = Math.max(0, this.staggerT - dt)
418: 
419:     // attack state machine
420:     if (this.attackT >= 0) {
421:       this.attackT += dt
422:       const windup = this.type.windup
423:       const strikeAt = windup + 0.14
424:       if (!this.attackHitDone && this.attackT >= strikeAt) {
425:         this.attackHitDone = true
426:         this._doAttackHit(player, dist)
427:       }
428:       if (this.attackT > windup + 0.62) {
429:         this.attackT = -1
430:         this.attackCooldown = this.type.attackCooldown * rand(0.8, 1.2)
431:       }
432:     } else if (player.alive && dist < this._reach() && this.attackCooldown <= 0 && this.staggerT <= 0 && this.canAttack) {
433:       this.attackT = 0
434:       this.attackHitDone = false
435:       this.game.audio.gurgle(this._pan())
436:     }
437: 
438:     // movement
439:     let moveSpeed = 0
440:     if (this.staggerT <= 0 && this.attackT < 0) {
441:       const want = this._reach() * 0.72
442:       let mx = 0, mz = 0
443:       if (dist > want + 0.15) {
444:         mx = dx / (dist || 1); mz = dz / (dist || 1)
445:       } else if (dist < want - 0.4) {
446:         mx = -dx / (dist || 1); mz = -dz / (dist || 1)
447:       }
448:       // strafe
449:       if (dist < this._reach() * 1.9) {
450:         const s = Math.sin(this.aliveTime * 1.3 + this.offset) * 0.55
451:         mx += (-dz / (dist || 1)) * s
452:         mz += (dx / (dist || 1)) * s
453:       }
454:       // separation
455:       for (const o of enemies) {
456:         if (o === this || o.dead) continue
457:         const ox = this.root.position.x - o.root.position.x
458:         const oz = this.root.position.z - o.root.position.z
459:         const d2 = ox * ox + oz * oz
460:         if (d2 < 2.2 && d2 > 0.0001) {
461:           const d = Math.sqrt(d2)
462:           mx += (ox / d) * (1.5 - d) * 0.75
463:           mz += (oz / d) * (1.5 - d) * 0.75
464:         }
465:       }
466:       const ml = Math.hypot(mx, mz)
467:       if (ml > 0.001) {
468:         mx /= ml; mz /= ml
469:         const spdMul = this.crawl ? (legsLost > 1 ? 0.16 : 0.34) : 1
470:         moveSpeed = this.type.speed * spdMul * (this.attackT >= 0 ? 0.15 : 1)
471:         this.root.position.x += mx * moveSpeed * dt
472:         this.root.position.z += mz * moveSpeed * dt
473:         this.targetYaw = Math.atan2(mx, mz)
474:       }
475:     }
476:     this.speed = damp(this.speed, moveSpeed, 8, dt)
477: 
478:     // clamp
479:     this.root.position.x = clamp(this.root.position.x, ARENA.playerMinX + 0.1, ARENA.playerMaxX - 0.1)
480:     this.root.position.z = clamp(this.root.position.z, ARENA.playerMinZ + 0.1, ARENA.playerMaxZ - 0.1)
481: 
482:     // face player when close / move direction otherwise
483:     if (dist < this._reach() * 1.8) this.targetYaw = Math.atan2(dx, dz)
484:     let dyaw = ((this.targetYaw - this.yaw + Math.PI * 3) % TAU) - Math.PI
485:     this.yaw += dyaw * Math.min(1, dt * 7)
486:     this.root.rotation.y = this.yaw
487: 
488:     this._animate(dt, dist)
489:   }
490: 
491:   _reach() {
492:     return this.type.reach * (this.crawl ? 0.7 : 1)
493:   }
494: 
495:   _pan() {
496:     const cam = this.game.player.camera
497:     return clamp((this.root.position.x - cam.position.x) / 14, -0.85, 0.85)
498:   }
499: 
500:   _doAttackHit(player, dist) {
501:     const reach = this._reach() + 0.3
502:     if (dist > reach || !player.alive) return
503:     const dx = player.position.x - this.root.position.x
504:     const dz = player.position.z - this.root.position.z
505:     const angleTo = Math.atan2(dx, dz)
506:     let diff = Math.abs(((angleTo - this.yaw + Math.PI * 3) % TAU) - Math.PI)
507:     if (diff > 1.2) return
508:     const arm = this.aliveArm('R') ? 'R' : (this.aliveArm('L') ? 'L' : null)
509:     if (!arm) return
510:     let dmg = this.type.damage
511:     if (!this.weapon) dmg *= 0.45
512:     if (this.crawl) dmg *= 0.7
513:     dmg *= 0.85 + this.manager.difficulty * 0.12
514:     player.damage(dmg, this.root.position)
515:     this.game.audio.flesh(0.8, this._pan(), false)
516:     this.game.gore.bloodBurst(new THREE.Vector3(player.position.x, 1.2, player.position.z), new THREE.Vector3(dx, 0.4, dz).normalize(), 5, 0.6, 0.5)
517:   }
518: 
519:   _animate(dt, dist) {
520:     const t = this.aliveTime
521:     const rig = this.rig
522:     const moving = this.speed > 0.2
523:     const crawl = this.crawlAmt
524:     const crouch = clamp(1 - crawl, 0, 1)
525: 
526:     // hips height and torso lean
527:     const targetHipY = lerp(0.98, 0.42, crawl)
528:     this.hips.position.y = damp(this.hips.position.y, targetHipY, 6, dt)
529:     const targetTorsoX = lerp(0.0, 1.18, crawl)
530:     let torsoX = damp(this.torsoUpper.rotation.x, targetTorsoX, 6, dt)
531:     let torsoY = 0
532: 
533:     // walk cycle
534:     const amp = this.crawl ? 0.45 : clamp(this.speed / 3, 0, 1) * 0.55
535:     const ph = this.walkPhase + (this.speed > 0.1 ? dt * this.speed * 2.4 : 0)
536:     this.walkPhase = ph
537:     const sw = Math.sin(ph) * amp
538:     const sw2 = Math.cos(ph) * amp
539: 
540:     if (!this.parts.legL.fractured && !this.parts.legL.lost) {
541:       rig.hips.L.rotation.x = sw
542:       if (!this.parts.legLLower.fractured) rig.knees.L.rotation.x = Math.max(0, -sw) * 1.3 + 0.04
543:     }
544:     if (!this.parts.legR.fractured && !this.parts.legR.lost) {
545:       rig.hips.R.rotation.x = -sw
546:       if (!this.parts.legRLower.fractured) rig.knees.R.rotation.x = Math.max(0, sw) * 1.3 + 0.04
547:     }
548:     if (this.parts.legLLower.lost) rig.knees.L.rotation.x = lerp(rig.knees.L.rotation.x, -0.4, dt * 4)
549:     if (this.parts.legRLower.lost) rig.knees.R.rotation.x = lerp(rig.knees.R.rotation.x, -0.4, dt * 4)
550: 
551:     // arms idle/walk
552:     let armSwingL = -sw * 0.7
553:     let armSwingR = sw * 0.7
554:     if (this.aliveArm('L')) {
555:       rig.shoulders.L.rotation.x = damp(rig.shoulders.L.rotation.x, armSwingL + (crawl ? -1.55 : 0.08), 8, dt)
556:       rig.shoulders.L.rotation.z = damp(rig.shoulders.L.rotation.z, crawl ? -0.25 : 0.09, 8, dt)
557:     }
558:     if (this.aliveArm('R')) {
559:       rig.shoulders.R.rotation.x = damp(rig.shoulders.R.rotation.x, armSwingR + (crawl ? -1.55 : 0.08), 8, dt)
560:       rig.shoulders.R.rotation.z = damp(rig.shoulders.R.rotation.z, crawl ? 0.25 : -0.09, 8, dt)
561:     }
562: 
563:     // crawl paddle
564:     if (crawl > 0.1) {
565:       if (this.aliveArm('L')) rig.shoulders.L.rotation.x = -1.7 + Math.sin(t * 5 + 1) * 0.55 * crawl
566:       if (this.aliveArm('R')) rig.shoulders.R.rotation.x = -1.7 + Math.sin(t * 5) * 0.55 * crawl
567:     }
568: 
569:     // attack animation
570:     if (this.attackT >= 0) {
571:       const windup = this.type.windup
572:       const k = this.attackT
573:       const arm = this.aliveArm('R') ? 'R' : 'L'
574:       const sgn = arm === 'R' ? 1 : -1
575:       if (k < windup) {
576:         const p = k / windup
577:         rig.shoulders[arm].rotation.x = lerp(rig.shoulders[arm].rotation.x, -2.15, p)
578:         rig.shoulders[arm].rotation.z = sgn * lerp(0.1, 0.55, p)
579:         torsoY = sgn * 0.42 * p
580:       } else if (k < windup + 0.28) {
581:         const p = clamp((k - windup) / 0.28, 0, 1)
582:         rig.shoulders[arm].rotation.x = lerp(-2.15, 0.85, p)
583:         rig.shoulders[arm].rotation.z = sgn * lerp(0.55, -0.35, p)
584:         torsoY = sgn * lerp(0.42, -0.4, p)
585:       } else {
586:         const p = clamp((k - windup - 0.28) / 0.34, 0, 1)
587:         rig.shoulders[arm].rotation.x = lerp(0.85, 0.08, p)
588:         torsoY = sgn * lerp(-0.4, 0, p)
589:       }
590:       // left arm counterbalance
591:       const other = arm === 'R' ? 'L' : 'R'
592:       if (this.aliveArm(other)) rig.shoulders[other].rotation.x = lerp(rig.shoulders[other].rotation.x, 0.6, 0.2)
593:     }
594: 
595:     // stagger
596:     if (this.staggerT > 0) {
597:       const s = this.staggerT / 0.5
598:       this.hips.rotation.z = Math.sin(t * 40) * 0.08 * s
599:       this.hips.rotation.x = -0.18 * s
600:       torsoX -= 0.25 * s
601:     } else {
602:       this.hips.rotation.z = damp(this.hips.rotation.z, 0, 6, dt)
603:       this.hips.rotation.x = damp(this.hips.rotation.x, 0, 6, dt)
604:     }
605: 
606:     this.torsoUpper.rotation.x = damp(this.torsoUpper.rotation.x, torsoX, 10, dt)
607:     this.torsoUpper.rotation.y = damp(this.torsoUpper.rotation.y, torsoY, 12, dt)
608: 
609:     // slow head tracking / jawless head loll
610:     if (this.parts.head.lost) {
611:       // no head
612:     } else if (this.parts.jaw.lost) {
613:       this.neck.rotation.z = Math.sin(t * 1.7) * 0.09
614:       this.neck.rotation.x = 0.12 + Math.sin(t * 0.9) * 0.05
615:     } else {
616:       this.neck.rotation.x = damp(this.neck.rotation.x, -0.05, 4, dt)
617:     }
618:   }
619: 
620:   _updateDeath(dt) {
621:     this.deathT += dt
622:     const k = clamp(this.deathT / 0.75, 0, 1)
623:     const e = 1 - Math.pow(1 - k, 3)
624:     if (this.cause === 'bisect') {
625:       this.hips.position.y = damp(this.hips.position.y, 0.26, 5, dt)
626:       this.root.rotation.z = lerp(0, this.deathDir * 1.35, e)
627:       this.root.rotation.x = lerp(0, 0.18, e)
628:     } else {
629:       this.hips.position.y = lerp(0.98, 0.26, e)
630:       this.root.rotation.x = lerp(0, -this.deathDir * 1.42, e)
631:       this.root.rotation.z = lerp(0, this.deathDir * 0.12, e)
632:     }
633:     if (this.deathT > 0.9 && !this.poolDone) {
634:       this.poolDone = true
635:       this.gore.bloodPool(this.root.position, 1.3)
636:       this.gore.bloodBurst(new THREE.Vector3(this.root.position.x, 0.6, this.root.position.z), new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), 6, 0.5, 0.8)
637:       if (this.cause === 'vital') this.game.audio.gurgle(this._pan())
638:     }
639:   }

641:   _updateFlash() {
642:     const on = this.flash > 0
643:     for (const m of this.materials) {
644:       if (m.emissive) {
645:         if (on) m.emissive.setRGB(0.32, 0.02, 0.02)
646:         else m.emissive.setRGB(0, 0, 0)
647:       }
648:     }
649:   }

651:   // -------------------------------------------------------- damage & gore
652:   takeHit(part, damage, weapon, dir, point) {
653:     if (this.dead || !part || part.lost) return
654:     this.lastWeapon = weapon
655:     this.flash = 0.13
656:     this.staggerT = Math.max(this.staggerT, 0.32)
657:     this.health -= damage * part.vital
658:     this.game.audio.flesh(1, this._pan(), weapon === 'hammer')
659:     const bd = dir.clone().normalize()
660:     bd.y = Math.abs(bd.y) + 0.35
661:     this.gore.bloodBurst(point, bd, weapon === 'hammer' ? 22 : 13, weapon === 'hammer' ? 1.6 : 1.1, 0.9)
662:     this._addBloodMark(part, point)
663: 
664:     let partDamage = damage * (weapon === 'hammer' ? 1.45 : 1)
665:     if (part.kind === 'torso') {
666:       this.cutTorso += partDamage
667:       if (weapon === 'sword' && this.cutTorso >= 205) {
668:         this._bisect(point, dir)
669:         return
670:       }
671:       if (weapon === 'hammer' && this.health <= 0) {
672:         this._burstChest(point, dir)
673:         return
674:       }
675:     }
676:     part.hp -= partDamage
677: 
678:     if (part.hp <= 0) {
679:       if (weapon === 'sword') {
680:         if (part.kind === 'head') { this._splitHead(point, dir); return }
681:         if (part.kind === 'jaw') { this._severJaw(point, dir); return }
682:         if (part.kind === 'arm' || part.kind === 'forearm') { this._severArm(part, point, dir); }
683:         if (part.kind === 'leg' || part.kind === 'shin') { this._severLeg(part, point, dir); }
684:       } else {
685:         if (part.kind === 'head') { this._burstHead(point, dir); return }
686:         if (part.kind === 'jaw') { this._breakJaw(point, dir); return }
687:         if (part.kind === 'arm' || part.kind === 'forearm') { this._fractureArm(part, point, dir); }
688:         if (part.kind === 'leg' || part.kind === 'shin') { this._fractureLeg(part, point, dir); }
689:         if (part.kind === 'torso' && this.health <= 0) { this._burstChest(point, dir); return }
690:       }
691:     }
692: 
693:     if (this.health <= 0 && !this.dead) this.die('vital', dir)
694:   }

696:   _addBloodMark(part, worldPoint) {
697:     if (part.lost || this.bloodMarks > 10) return
698:     const local = part.group.worldToLocal(worldPoint.clone())
699:     const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
700:       map: this.gore.bloodTex, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide,
701:       opacity: rand(0.65, 0.95), polygonOffset: true, polygonOffsetFactor: -2
702:     })
703:     const plane = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1, 1), mat)
704:     plane.position.copy(local)
705:     plane.scale.setScalar(rand(0.12, 0.28))
706:     plane.rotation.z = rand(0, TAU)
707:     plane.renderOrder = 2
708:     part.group.add(plane)
709:     this.bloodMarks++

712:   _stump(parent, localPos, radius = 0.07, bone = true, dir = null) {
713:     const stump = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(radius, 8, 6), this.gore._mats.blood)
714:     stump.position.copy(localPos)
715:     stump.scale.set(1.15, 1.15, 0.55)

717:     if (bone) {
718:       this.gore.boneSpike(parent, localPos, dir || new THREE.Vector3(rand(-0.4, 0.4), 1, rand(-0.4, 0.4)), rand(0.1, 0.18))
719:     }
720:     this.gore.addBleeder(parent, localPos, rand(2.4, 4.2), rand(20, 32), 1)

723:   _detachLimb(part, point, dir, opts = {}) {
724:     if (part.lost) return
725:     const group = part.group
726:     const parent = group.parent
727:     const local = group.position.clone()
728:     part.lost = true
729:     part.hp = 0

731:     group.getWorldPosition(worldPos)
732:     if (part.side === 'R') this._dropWeapon(dir)
733:     const vel = dir.clone().multiplyScalar(rand(1.2, 2.6))
734:     vel.y += rand(1, 2.6)
735:     this.gore.addChunk(group, vel, new THREE.Vector3(rand(-7, 7), rand(-7, 7), rand(-7, 7)), { gore: true })
736:     this.gore.bloodBurst(worldPos, dir.clone().multiplyScalar(-1), 20, 1.5, 1)
737:     this.gore.bloodPool(worldPos, 0.55)
738:     this._stump(parent, local, opts.radius || 0.065, true, dir)
739:     this.limbsLost++
740:     // if upper part removed, mark lower parts lost logically
741:     if (opts.lower && this.parts[opts.lower]) this.parts[opts.lower].lost = true
742:     if (opts.upper && this.parts[opts.upper]) this.parts[opts.upper].lost = true
743:     this.game.audio.sever(this._pan(), true)

784:       this.gore.boneSpike(part.group, new THREE.Vector3(0, -0.34, 0), new THREE.Vector3(rand(-0.4, 0.4), 0.4, rand(0.2, 0.7)), 0.18)
785:       this.gore.addBleeder(part.group, new THREE.Vector3(0, -0.34, 0), 3.0, 24, 1)

787:     this.gore.bloodBurst(point, dir, 22, 1.5, 1)

911:     this.parts.armL.lost = true; this.parts.armLLower.lost = true
912:     this.parts.armR.lost = true; this.parts.armRLower.lost = true
913:     this.parts.head.lost = true; this.parts.jaw.lost = true

915:     this.gore.addBleeder(this.hips, new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.26, 0), 6, 36, 1.6)
916:     this.gore.bloodBurst(waist, new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.8, 0), 34, 1.9, 1)

932:       rib.position.copy(wp).add(new THREE.Vector3(rand(-0.15, 0.15), rand(-0.1, 0.15), rand(-0.1, 0.1)))
933:       rib.rotation.set(rand(-1, 1), rand(-1, 1), rand(-1, 1))
934:       this.scene.add(rib)
935:       this.gore.addChunk(rib, new THREE.Vector3(rand(-2, 2), rand(1, 3), rand(-2, 2)), new THREE.Vector3(rand(-9, 9), rand(-9, 9), rand(-9, 9)), { gore: true })
936:     }
937:     this.gore.bloodBurst(wp, dir, 36, 2, 1)
938:     this.gore.addBleeder(this.torsoUpper, new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.18, 0), 5, 30, 1.4)
939:     this.game.audio.crunch(this._pan(), 1.8)

943:   _dropWeapon(dir = null) {
944:     if (!this.weapon || this.weaponDropped) return
945:     this.weaponDropped = true
946:     const w = this.weapon
947:     this.weapon = null
948:     const wp = new THREE.Vector3()
949:     w.getWorldPosition(wp)
950:     const vel = new THREE.Vector3(dir ? dir.x * 2.2 : rand(-1, 1), rand(1.2, 2.5), dir ? dir.z * 2.2 : rand(-1, 1))
951:     this.gore.addChunk(w, vel, new THREE.Vector3(rand(-9, 9), rand(-9, 9), rand(-9, 9)), { gore: false, ttl: 30 })
952:     this.game.audio.clang(this._pan())
953:     this.game.ui.toast(`${this.type.label} DISARMED`, 1100)
954:   }

957:     if (this.dead) return
958:     this.dead = true
959:     this.deathT = 0
960:     this.cause = cause
961:     this.deathDir = (dir && dir.x >= 0) ? 1 : -1
962:     this.attackT = -1
963:     if (this.weapon && Math.random() < 0.55) this._dropWeapon(dir)
964:     this.game.onEnemyKilled(this, cause)
965:   }

968: export class EnemyManager {
969:   constructor(game, scene, gore) {
970:     this.game = game
971:     this.scene = scene
972:     this.gore = gore
973:     this.enemies = []
974:     this.difficulty = 0
975:     this.raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster()
976:     this._v = new THREE.Vector3()
977:     this._v2 = new THREE.Vector3()
978:     this._tmp = new THREE.Vector3()
979:   }
980: 
981:   spawn(typeName, gateIndex = randInt(0, 2)) {
982:     const gx = ARENA.gates[gateIndex % ARENA.gates.length]
983:     const x = gx + rand(-1.0, 1.0)
984:     const z = ARENA.gateZ - rand(0.1, 0.5)
985:     const e = new Enemy(this, typeName, x, z)
986:     this.enemies.push(e)
987:     this.gore.dustPuff(new THREE.Vector3(x, 0.12, z + 0.7), 6, 0x9a7d55)
988:     return e
989:   }
990: 
991:   get alive() {
992:     return this.enemies.filter(e => !e.dead)
993:   }
994: 
995:   get aliveCount() {
996:     let n = 0
997:     for (const e of this.enemies) if (!e.dead) n++
998:     return n
999:   }
1000: 
1001:   update(dt, player) {
